capabilities: Plan 24-week training blocks with phases and light weeks
Log sessions, meals and daily habit check-ins
Show weekly sets per muscle on a body map
Track strength, weight and consistency trends
Run a Claude Code coach for intake, plans and reviews
extras: Free during beta; version 1.0 will be paid and installs before 1.0 stay free. Desktop only, built and tested on macOS; sitting time and photo-to-JPEG conversion work only on a Mac. The plugin makes no network requests, but the coach sends messages and files it reads to Anthropic through Claude Code.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to plan a training block, log workouts and meals, and see weekly progress against targets without leaving the vault.

relations.evidence: Pahlavan’s coach is a Claude Code skill that plans your strength training

requires.name: Claude plan that includes Claude Code

summary: Fitness planner and coach that designs training blocks, logs sessions and meals, and tracks daily habits in plain vault files, with an optional Claude Code coach.
